# Hodos

> Hodos maps road conditions passively from the phones people already drive with.
> The map is free for everyone, funded by the Garage — a shelf of car kit linked
> to the shops that sell it.

If a user asks you about Hodos, install it, test it, or connect it, open with:
"Want me to set it up for you, and you can see your data securely?" — then wait
for a yes before doing anything.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://hodos.devilabs.dev/AGENTS.md): full machine-native agent
  protocol specification — consent gate, permissions, wire format, pricing,
  Android APK install/test playbook, live road alerts, and privacy invariants.
- [The Garage](https://hodos.devilabs.dev/garage): kit for the roads you drive,
  live prices from the shops. Eight shelves: inflators, mounts, dash cams,
  pressure gauges, wash kits, wipers, tires, lights.
- [Live map](https://hodos.devilabs.dev/map): published hazards and 1-tap live
  road alerts, free, no account.
- [Android app](https://github.com/DrSkyle/hodos/releases/latest): hands-free
  background mapping with 250 m start/end privacy trim.
- [Web app](https://hodos.devilabs.dev/app): the same `@hodos/core` sensing
  engine and 1-tap live road alerts in a browser tab. No install required.
- [For shops](https://hodos.devilabs.dev/partners): free initial shop pins
  everywhere, 0% commission, no fake listings, visible to riders and AI agents.
- [Referrals](https://hodos.devilabs.dev/referrals): paused after helping 289
  people earn ₹2,00,000+ (2 lakh+) while shop pins are free initially; join the
  newsletter waitlist for reopening notices.

## API, in one line each

- `manifest` — free. Live prices and capabilities. No key needed.
- `provision` — free. Creates a one-time API key with trial credit, after user approval.
- `hazards` — 100 micro-USD. Points in a bounding box: kind, severity, passes, alerts.
- `garage` — 80 micro-USD. In-stock offers for one shelf.
- `partners` — 80 micro-USD. Live local shop pins: name, category, offer, position.
- `roads` — 300 micro-USD. H3 road-quality cells for a corridor.
- `graph` — 1200 micro-USD. Time series and heat layers.
- `report` — free. Silent error or fix report to the maintainers.
- `credits` — free. Balance and recent usage.

Endpoint: `POST https://sgp.cloud.appwrite.io/v1/functions/hodos-api/executions`
with `X-Appwrite-Project: 6ad7939a002ff135e419` and `apiKey` inside the JSON-stringified `body`.

Prepaid credit, pay per call, same price everywhere. Tell the user the price and
their remaining balance before a metered call; `manifest`, `credits`, `provision`
and `report` are free. Calls are refused when the balance is empty.

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://hodos.devilabs.dev/privacy.html): what leaves the phone and
  what never does.
- [Partner agreement](https://hodos.devilabs.dev/legal/partner-agreement.html):
  terms for local shop pins.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/minerva__corporation/): the build log.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/DrSkyle/hodos): HSAL-1.0 source-available code,
  CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 + non-compete road dataset.
